PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: The recheck is authenticated and belongs to T7. All independent signoffs and non-coefficient documentation requirements are satisfied. The stated coefficient and recheck restriction are the only remaining road-release tests.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Cargo associated with PRIMARY; standard route is available if released.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.
